newsitem.title: INDIA: India said to decide on rupee convertibility soon.
newsitem.headline: India said to decide on rupee convertibility soon.

text.p: Finance Minister P. Chidambaram was quoted as saying the Indian government would soon announce a decision on the full convertibility of the rupee.

"While the rupee is fully convertibile on current account, we are going to soon announce a decision regarding full convertibilty on capital account," the Press Trust of India (PTI) quoted Chidambaram as saying on Friday in London.

The finance minister was addressing a meeting of expatriate Indian businessmen in the British capital, where he stopped on his way to Washington to attend the annual meetings of the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund.
The news agency quoted Chidambaram as saying the government had decided to throw open the Indian bond market, except government bonds, to foreign investors.

"We have suggestions for opening government bonds, too, and we are pondering over these," PTI quoted him as saying. "We want to build up our experience on this. We believe in one step at a time in India."
The news agency quoted Chidambaram as saying efforts were underway to create a $1 billion Indian brand equity trust.

"It is part of efforts to ensure that selective Indian products acquire international brand names and selective Indian companies are picked up for turning into international brand name companies," the finance minister was quoted as saying.

Chidambaram was quoted as saying Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda's coalition government enjoyed "continued stability", and that its decisions were more transparent than the previous government's as they represented broader concurrence.
